vetSays.line: 🛡️ Easton, Xavier and Omar met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Easton, Xavier, Omar are hurt.
🛡️ Easton, Xavier and Omar met them at the door — 3 put down. Easton, Xavier, Omar are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jasper just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Easton, Jasper and Xavier met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Easton is hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Easton, DeShawn, Jasper, Xavier and Jorge met them at the door — 3 put down, 2 barely walked away. Easton, DeShawn, Jasper, Xavier, Jorge are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Loud Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Mia. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Mia strikes the Pack-leader The Loud Beast.
The Pack-leader The Loud Beast falls.
📺 Mia brought down Pack-leader The Loud Beast, The Loud Beast (packmate). Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📓 Codex: A person, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm — jotted down what they said. Filed.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Silke, Omsin and Boris met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Silke, Omsin, Boris are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Kazuo just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Stefano just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Davi just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Davi just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Davi met them at the door — 1 put down. Davi is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
